integrity: The proof is analytic; the standalone checker supplies bounded exact-rational and high-precision diagnostics. Published-source comparisons cannot certify worldwide publication priority. No independent validation or audit performed.
scientific_limitations: This is a theorem for two independently switched two-sex F-quadratic simplex maps with distinct contractions, strictly positive reproductive coordinates initially, and nondegenerate constant switching bias. The exact dyadic Bernoulli measure theory used in the proof is classical. No assertion for arbitrary nonlinear stochastic operators or correlated switching.
title: Extinction-rate singularity transition for randomly switched two-sex quadratic maps
